ValidationRule.description: to ensure case status is escalated when ingested complaint is converted to Customer/Non-Customer Complaint
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( $Setup.Salesforce_Library_Settings__c.Disable_VRs__c = false, OR( RecordType.DeveloperName = 'Customer_Complaint', RecordType.DeveloperName = 'Non_Customer_Complaint' ), NOT(ISPICKVAL(Status, 'Escalated')), ISCHANGED(RecordTypeId), ANZx_Customer__c = false, NOT(ISPICKVAL(Origin, 'ANZ Plus Web')) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Case Status must be updated to 'Escalated'
